Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface ArticleIngestionPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
ArticleIngestionAdapter
public interface ArticleIngestionPort
Outbound port — fetch articles from external sources for a given topic.

Implementations live in infrastructure/ingestion. The domain and application layers depend only on this interface; no HTTP, RSS, or scraping details leak inward.

For Slice 1 the implementation performs a direct HTTP fetch of a supplied URL list. Future slices may add RSS readers, news API clients, or a configurable source registry without changing this contract.

  • Method Details

    • fetchArticles

      List<NewsArticle> fetchArticles(String topic, int maxArticles)
      Fetch up to maxArticles articles relevant to the given topic.
      Parameters:
      topic - Search keyword or phrase (e.g. "AI in healthcare 2025").
      maxArticles - Maximum number of articles to return; must be > 0.
      Returns:
      An unordered list of ingested articles; may be empty if no results are found.

    • fetchAllByTopic

      List<NewsArticle> fetchAllByTopic(String topic)
      Fetch all articles for the given topic with no date restriction.

      Used by the analytics dashboard detail view to show the complete article list that matches the analytics count, bypassing any days-back window applied by fetchArticles(java.lang.String, int).

      Parameters:
      topic - exact topic label to filter by (case-insensitive substring match)
      Returns:
      all matching articles; may be empty if no results are found

    • fetchByTopicWithArchiveLimit

      List<NewsArticle> fetchByTopicWithArchiveLimit(String topic, int archiveDays)
      Fetch all articles for the given topic, restricted to articles created within the last archiveDays days. If archiveDays is 0, no date restriction is applied (unlimited archive access).

      Used by tier-gated UI pages to enforce archive depth limits per subscription tier (e.g. FREE sees last 7 days, SUBSCRIBER sees all).

      Parameters:
      topic - exact topic label to filter by (case-insensitive substring match)
      archiveDays - maximum article age in days; 0 = unlimited
      Returns:
      matching articles within the date window; may be empty

    • fetchArticlesByIds

      List<NewsArticle> fetchArticlesByIds(List<String> articleIds)
      Fetch specific articles by their unique identifiers.

      Used by the prompt evaluation framework to load known articles for controlled experiments. Articles not found in the database are silently skipped; callers should verify the returned list size.

      Parameters:
      articleIds - List of article IDs to fetch.
      Returns:
      The matching articles; may be smaller than the input list if some IDs are missing.

    • fetchRecentArticles

      List<NewsArticle> fetchRecentArticles(int days)
      Fetch all articles created within the last days days, regardless of topic.

      Used by the trend detection engine to analyze keyword frequency across the entire article corpus within a rolling time window.

      Parameters:
      days - number of days to look back; must be > 0
      Returns:
      all articles created within the window; may be empty

    • fetchArticlesByDateRange

      List<NewsArticle> fetchArticlesByDateRange(Instant from, Instant to)
      Fetch all articles created between from and to (inclusive), regardless of topic.

      Used by the trend detection date-range filter to analyze keyword frequency across a user-specified time window.

      Parameters:
      from - start of the date range (inclusive); must not be null
      to - end of the date range (inclusive); must not be null
      Returns:
      all articles created within the range; may be empty
